scope: Measured local concave bevels, general AA and square joins without text detection; immediate source3x3 RGB bounds; optional complex hinted glyph repairs; no de-dithering.
architecture: Source-supported geometry including measured3-arm notches; existing3x3/flagged5x5 masked tables and local RGB-range guard. Prepared single-cell bevel blocks reuse cache169.

general_aa_policy.square_junctions: No hints: source-supported T/+ with sparse priority over AA units; one/two-pixel strokes and short arms.

local_thin_corner.requires: Two adjacent contrasted foreground arms, four background diagonals, Q8 mixture48..220 with shared RGB residual<=144, actual radius-two foreground continuation; square junctions win.

mixed_coverage_corner.requires: Three repeated foreground and two repeated observed background samples, all25 on a high-contrast RGB segment within squared residual144; two adjacent high arms/four low diagonals, real continuation and an intermediate low shade; fractional centres48..220/Q8 or opaque>=240. Opaque one-arm caps also require continued stem/front field.
mixed_coverage_corner.prepared_cache: Sparse block code169; fully opaque copies use code5; square joins and multi-block AA units retain priority.

local_square_junction.requires: Source-exact two-colour T/+ core with four square background quadrants, at least3foreground arms and one radius2continuation; reject diagonal returns at short arms and foreground across the empty arm. Outer bevel colours do not define the core. Existing hint-boundary guards apply.

coverage_corner.requires: 3or4actual source colours, contrast>=6912 and all25samples on the observed RGB segment with squared residual<=36; repeated endpoints, Q8 fractional coverage and source-supported convex-cut/weak-diagonal continuation. Opaque elbow needs both continued arms. A core endpoint needs opaque-elbow geometry before full fitting.
coverage_corner.prepared_cache: Reuse existing sparse169 fitted blocks and5solid copies; square joins and accepted multi-block/gap/notch/bowl units retain priority.

local_rgb_range.bound: Per-channel RGB minimum/maximum, including centre; replicated frame borders. Wider geometry evidence cannot expand these limits. Applies to hinted/unhinted reconstruction in RGB/BGRA.
local_rgb_range.runtime: Final guard on authored non-copy blocks; ordinary local convex copy/LUT/HQ paths are bounded by construction. NEON/scalar exact; no additional allocation.
local_rgb_range.coverage_priority: Local bounds take precedence over wider-field ideal coverage; clipped block means may change.

measured_concave_bevel.continuation: Two-step closed foreground stem; three core foreground arms, one open background face, four background quadrants.
measured_concave_bevel.requires: Contrast>=6912, centre Q8 96..220, squared mixture residual<=36, coherent repeated endpoints and uniform5x5hint scope. Opaque/binary T/+ and weak unsupported centres reject.
measured_concave_bevel.output: One source-cell3x3block; symmetric45-degree V coverage with phase matched to measured alpha. Existing square joins, gaps and accepted multi-block units retain priority.
measured_concave_bevel.cache: 257x9Q8 analytic coverage table initialized once, existing sparse prepared169blocks. V48 local RGB bounds remain.
